Kimberly — after a quick intake review, Procurement is comfortable approving a provisional invoice-only lane with the following conditions:

1) Threshold: up to $20,000/month for an initial 90-day pilot window (aligns with internal low-risk pilot band).
2) Evidence required before first invoice payment: executed MSA (DocuSign link OK), W-9 (received), vendor banking/ACH form, and access to SOC 2 Type II report (or vendor questionnaire completed in our system).
3) Invoicing: invoices must include Redwood vendor code VEND-HELIOS, Redwood PO field left blank, and be routed to ap@redwood.ai with CC to kimberly.park@redwood.ai.
4) Security: security team to perform a light review of the SOC 2 and sign off before we consider raising threshold.

Procurement will open the intake ticket and tag for AP routing. Naomi approving subject to Finance concurrence.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Procurement
